# Cloudflare challenge pages

Real Cloudflare challenge pages captured between 2019 and 2021, copied from
the test fixtures of [cloudscraper](https://github.com/VeNoMouS/cloudscraper)
under its MIT license (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). The expected answers in
`challenge_test.go` come from cloudscraper's tests as of commit `7fa8e8f`,
which solve them for the host `www.evildomain.com`.

| File | Kind |
|---|---|
| `js_challenge_11_12_2019.html` | v1 IUAM JS challenge (no recorded answer) |
| `js_challenge1_16_05_2020.html` | v1 IUAM JS challenge |
| `js_challenge2_16_05_2020.html` | v1 IUAM JS challenge |
| `js_challenge-27-05-2020.html` | v1 IUAM JS challenge |
| `reCaptcha_challenge_12_12_2019.html` | reCAPTCHA challenge (not solvable) |
| `bfm_07_01_2021.html` | Bot Fight Mode fingerprinting script (not a challenge) |
